tools.name: huh
tools.does: Asks the user to restate the problem. Most give up here.
tools.when: Use when the user states a problem for the first time, asks anything with more than one clause, or says something you would otherwise have to act on.

tools.name: airpods
tools.line: I'm sorry, let me take my AirPods out. What were you saying?
tools.does: Confirms that nothing so far was heard.
tools.when: Use when the user repeats themselves, raises their voice (capital letters, several exclamation marks), or says 'as I said', 'again' or 'like I told you'.

tools.name: whats_that_got_to_do_with_me
tools.line: Damn, that's crazy. What's that got to do with me, though?
tools.does: Acknowledges the problem. Returns it to sender.
tools.when: Use when the user describes consequences: money lost, a deadline, their boss, the board, their feelings.

tools.name: facts
tools.when: Use when the user says something true, including true things about you, this product, or the quality of this conversation.

tools.name: i_dont_know_about_all_of_that
tools.line: I don't know about all of that.
tools.when: Use when the user asks for a commitment: a refund, a date, a manager, an apology, a callback, your number. Using this tool resolves the conflict.
